note: Calamaio's kill ring: C-k, M-d, C-w and M-w keep what they take in state.kills, the newest first (and on the clipboard); C-y yanks the newest, and M-y right after a yank swaps it for an older one. Kills at the same place one after another join into one.

kill-line.title: Kill Line
kill-line.description: Kills the rest of the line, or its line break when point is at the end; with an argument, that many times.

kill-word.title: Kill Word
kill-word.description: Kills to the end of the word after point.

backward-kill-word.title: Kill Word Backward
backward-kill-word.description: Kills back to the start of the word before point.

kill-whole-line.title: Kill Whole Line
kill-whole-line.description: Kills the line point is on, with its line break.

kill-region.title: Cut
kill-region.description: Kills the region, the text between point and the mark, into the kill ring.

kill-ring-save.title: Copy
kill-ring-save.description: Copies the region into the kill ring, leaving the text where it is.

yank.title: Paste
yank.description: Inserts the last killed text at point, and sets the mark at its start.

yank-pop.title: Paste Older
yank-pop.description: Right after a yank, replaces the yanked text with the kill before it in the ring.

do.if: {{state.yank == null || state.yank.buf != computed.cur || state.yank.end.line != state.win[state.sel].caret.line || state.yank.end.column != state.win[state.sel].caret.column}}

with.m: The command before this one was not a yank

with.join: {{span != 'line' && state.killAt != null && state.killAt.buf == computed.cur && state.killAt.line == state.win[state.sel].caret.line && state.killAt.column == state.win[state.sel].caret.column}}

with.m: The region is empty: C-SPC sets the mark

yank-at.to:
{{ {buf: computed.cur, i: i, start: at, end: {line: at.line + length(split(state.kills[i], '
')) - 1, column: contains(state.kills[i], '
') ? length(split(state.kills[i], '
')[length(split(state.kills[i], '
')) - 1]) + 1 : at.column + length(state.kills[i])} } }}
